scripts.create-opsiforce-db: kubectl run -n local psql-client --restart=Never -i --tty --rm --env PGPASSWORD=dbpass1 --image=postgres:16 -- psql -h local-pg-postgresql -d postgres -U admin -c "CREATE DATABASE opsiforce;" || :
scripts.opsiforce-install-proxy: helm upgrade --install --wait --create-namespace --namespace local local-opsiforce-proxy ../../opsiforce/helm/opsiforce-proxy --set ingress.enabled=false --set ingressRoute.enabled=false --set affinity=null --set proxy.backendService=http://host.minikube.internal:3001 --set proxy.frontendService=http://host.minikube.internal:8084 --set oauth2Proxy.enabled=true --set oauth2Proxy.image=quay.io/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy:v7.13.0 --set oauth2Proxy.redisPath=redis://redis-session-storage-local-master.local.svc.cluster.local:6379/0 --set oauth2Proxy.clientId=opsiforce --set oauth2Proxy.clientSecret=opsiforce --set oauth2Proxy.cookieSecret=localsecretlocal --set oauth2Proxy.redirectUrl=http://localhost:4110 --set oauth2Proxy.issuerUrl=http://sima-keycloak-local-service:8086/realms/sima --set oauth2Proxy.logoutUrl='http://sima-keycloak-local-service:8086/realms/sima/protocol/openid-connect/logout?id_token_hint={id_token}'
scripts.port-forward-proxy: sh -c 'while true; do kubectl port-forward services/local-opsiforce-proxy 4110:4180 -n local; sleep 1; done'
scripts.build-agent-image: sh -c 'TAG=opsiforce-agent:$(node -p "require(\"../agent-config/agent-image-version.json\").version") && minikube image ls | grep -q "$TAG" && echo "Image $TAG already exists, skipping build" || minikube image build -t $TAG -f docker/Dockerfile.agent --build-opt=build-arg=OPENCODE_CONFIG=agent-config/opencode.local.json ..'
scripts.opsiforce-install-infra: helm upgrade --install --wait --namespace opsiforce --create-namespace opsiforce-infra ../helm/opsiforce --set fullnameOverride=opsiforce --set storage.type=hostPath --set storage.hostPath=/data/opsiforce --set valkey.enabled=false --set agent.affinity=null
scripts.kubectl-proxy: sh -c 'lsof -ti :8001 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; while true; do kubectl proxy --port=8001; sleep 1; done'
scripts.create-bifrost-db: kubectl run -n local psql-client-bf --restart=Never -i --tty --rm --env PGPASSWORD=dbpass1 --image=postgres:16 -- psql -h local-pg-postgresql -d postgres -U admin -c "CREATE DATABASE bifrost;" || :
scripts.port-forward-bifrost: sh -c 'while true; do kubectl port-forward svc/opsiforce-bifrost 3050:8080 -n opsiforce; sleep 1; done'
scripts.minikube-dev: env-cmd -f ./local-envs.sh --use-shell 'yarn run setup-minikube-storage && yarn run build-agent-image && yarn run opsiforce-install-infra && yarn run create-opsiforce-db && yarn run create-bifrost-db && yarn run db:migrate && yarn run install-bifrost && concurrently "yarn run opsiforce-install-proxy" "yarn run port-forward-proxy" "yarn run port-forward-bifrost" "yarn run kubectl-proxy" "yarn run dev" "yarn run db:studio"'
